<!-- This exercises is authored by Karsten Lübke. -->




```{r data generation, echo = FALSE, results = "hide"}
library(exams)
# Random Data
vtyp <- sample(c("Lage", "Streuung"),1)

## Questions
questions <- character(5)

if (vtyp == "Lage") {
  questions[1] <- "Median"
  questions[2] <- "Mittelwert"
  questions[3] <- "Minimum"
  questions[4] <- "Maximum"
  questions[5] <- "Korrelationskoeffizient"
  questions[6] <- "Quartil"
}

if (vtyp == "Streuung") {
  questions[1] <- "Interquartilsabstand"
  questions[2] <- "Spannweite"
  questions[3] <- "Varianz"
  questions[4] <- "Standardabweichung"
  questions[5] <- "Bestimmtheitsmaß"
  questions[6] <- "MAD_SD"
}

solutions <- rep(FALSE, 6)
solutions[1] <- TRUE
```

Question
========
  
Welche Kennzahl ist robust gegen Ausreißer?
  
```{r questionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
answerlist(questions, markup = "markdown")
```

Solution
========


Aufgabenname: `robustheit`


```{r solutionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
answerlist(ifelse(solutions, "Richtig", "Falsch"), markup = "markdown")
```
